pages.text: Garlic Bread restores seven hunger points with a saturation modifier of 0.8. Craft it from two Wheat, Garlic, Salt and an herb. Garlic is the built-in herb option, so this normally needs two Garlic. Other mods or data packs may extend the herb tag. Player vampirism and its original garlic-burning penalty remain unported.

A Hellhound Horn crafts into one Blaze Powder. A Frostflower crafts into one Snowball. Cracked or Chiseled Embittered Bricks each craft back into one ordinary Embittered Bricks block. Obtaining the main ingredient unlocks each recipe in the recipe book.
